title: Seafood Fideua with Chewy Paella Crust
description: A Spanish-inspired dish featuring seafood, fideua, and a crispy, chewy crust, all in one satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: Spanish mackerel
ingredients.notes: skinned and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: 2. Cook the fideua according to package instructions. Set aside.
3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
5. Add the shrimp and mackerel, and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until cooked through.
6. Add the cooked fideua to the skillet, and stir to combine.
7. Add the seafood seasoning, and stir to combine.
8. Transfer the mixture to a baking dish, and top with the cubed bread.
9. Drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle with parsley.
10. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
11. Bake for 10-12 minutes, until the bread is crispy and golden brown.
